scope: bounded local process-crash recovery on one Euler core-event day
fault_target: first emitted notification in each cell
clock_contract: deterministic event-time offsets; availability, feature-ready and decision clocks equal by declared zero modeled service delay; actual persistence costs measured separately
sink_contract: separate local SQLite database with unique alert_id and matching-payload enforcement; a duplicate delivery attempt is recorded without a second logical sink effect
limits: no kernel crash, power-loss or physical-disk durability claim
no external network or operator delivery measurement
no cross-chain or live reorg support
